The score varies depending on the amount of damage dealt to enemies, damage taken from enemies, and the number of quest missions completed.

Guts: When receiving damage that would reduce HP to 0, HP remains at 1.
Poison: At the start of the turn, takes damage based on the ATK of the character who applied it.
Burn: At the start of the turn, takes damage based on the ATK of the character who applied it.
Frostbite: ATK, DEF, and SPD decrease. At the start of the turn, takes damage based on the ATK of the character who applied it.
Shock: Damage Cut Multiplier decreases. At the start of the turn, takes damage based on the ATK of the character who applied it, and SP decreases by 1.
Paralysis: ATK and SPD decrease. At the start of the turn, SP decreases by 2.
Incurable: HP and SP do not recover.

During battle, characters may enter special states through skills and other effects.

Taunt: Enemies will target this character preferentially.
Guts: Even when hit by damage that would render them unable to battle, they survive with 1 HP.
Poison: Takes damage at the start of the turn. Does not recover naturally.
Burn: Takes damage at the start of the turn.
Frostbite: ATK, DEF, and SPD are reduced, and takes damage at the start of the turn.
Shock: Damage Cut Multiplier is reduced, takes damage at the start of the turn, and additionally loses 1 SP.
Paralysis: ATK and SPD are reduced, and loses 2 SP at the start of the turn.
Incurable: HP and SP cannot be recovered.
*Status changes other than Poison are basically resolved after a certain number of turns.
